method: Independent prototype-getter fixtures through production HalcRegions and current production HalcBoundaries/label scheduler. Real source/render/idle/error transitions use the shipped map adapter. No actual MVT, browser/GPU, or speed claim; actual MVT/CPU evidence is a separate performance-agent report.

results.name: Grouping keeps original gid type, truthy gate, first properties and query order without geometry demand
One fragment access decodes that fragment once, including reverse access order
Serialization preserves every group and fragment exactly against the previous eager algorithm
Region-first completion reaches readiness after its render with zero geometry and no premature ink
Metadata-only readiness still cannot commit grouped ink or perform a feature query
Hidden labels leave region coordinates untouched through both source arrivals and idle reuse
High-zoom local labels never materialize otherwise unused region polygons
Low-zoom exact regional anchors demand all fragments and retain the original grouped click target
New source epoch with the same gid cannot reuse previous geometry or fragment memoization
Error before rendered completion prevents new grouped state and leaves healthy local readiness intact
Changing year before region render forbids late grouping and requires a fresh eligible frame on return
Destroy before source completion removes listeners and prevents late grouping
